title: WPSS/1069/2013 of Hukam Singh Negi Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
 AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 1069 (SS) of 2013
Hukam Singh Negi. .ÖÖPetitioner.
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and another. ÖÖÖRespondents.
Present:
Mr. S.K. Posti, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Standing Counsel for State of Uttarakhand.
Honíble Alok Singh, J. (Oral)
Petitioner was initially appointed on the post of Clerk
on 08.04.1969 with Basic Education Board, Uttar Pradesh. Thereafter,
petitioner was promoted on the post of Head Clerk on 28.07.2000.
After creation of State of Uttarakhand, Uttarankhand School
Education Act, 2006 was enacted. As per Section 58 of the
Uttarakhand School Education Act, 2006, services of all the teaching
and non teaching staff posted with the Basic Education Board shall
stand transferred to the Government Department with effect from
publication of the Notification in the official Gazette. Notification
was published on 24.06.2006. Consequently, services of all the
teaching and non-teaching staff, working with the Basic Education
Board including the petitioner stood transferred to the Government
Department with effect from 22.04.2006. Hence, petitioner became
Government Servant with effect from 22.04.2006.
Vide Government Notification dated 03.06.2006
(Annexure No. 3 to the writ petition), it has been decided that the all
the Senior Assistants or Chief Assistants working in the pay scale of
` 4500ñ125-7000 or Head Clerk working in the pay scale of ` 4500ñ
125-7000 shall be re-designated as Administrative Officer Grade II
and shall be paid salary of ` 5000ñ150- 8000 instead of ` 4500ñ125-
7000.
Claim of the petitioner for grant of pay scale of
` 5000ñ150- 8000 was declined by the respondents on the ground
that prior to transfer of his service from Basic Education Board to the

2
State Government, pay scales of ministerial staff working with the
Government and Basic Education Board, were different.
On being asked, learned Standing Counsel for the State
fairly submits that after transfer of services of petitioner from Basic
Education Board to State Government, petitioner was discharging
the duties as Head Clerk and was working in the pay scale of `
4500ñ125-7000 which was being paid to other Senior Assistants or
Chief Assistants or Head Clerks working with the State
Government.
That being so, it can safely be concluded that pay scale
of Head Clerk, Senior Assistant or Chief Assistant was `
4500ñ125-7000, which has now been increased to ` 5000ñ150- 8000
and posts are re-designated as Administrative Officer Grade II,
therefore, in my considered opinion, petitioner is entitled for
enhanced pay scale of ` 5000ñ150- 8000 and denial to grant benefit of
Government Order dated 03.06.2006 cannot be said to be justified,
consequently, writ petition is allowed. Impugned order dated
19.06.2007 is hereby quashed. Respondents are directed to grant pay
scale of ` 5000ñ150- 8000 to the petitioner and to calculate the arrears
and release the amount arrears in favour of the petitioner within 90
days from today and if arrears are not paid within 90 days from
today, respondents shall pay interest @ 12 % per annum on the
amount of arrears from the date of passing of this judgment till the
actual payment is made. No order as to costs.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 20.12.2013
SKS
